versions.name: RXV2-0.9.792-search-heals-and-tells
versions.notes: Connect page: a search that hears nothing restarts itself every ten seconds, the seconds are counted by the link itself, the search comes back by itself after a trip to another app or a dropped link, and the page's help now ends with 'What the app did' - the link's own timestamped account of searching, hearing, connecting, failing and leaving - so a can't-connect can be read instead of guessed at.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.791-searching-says-more
versions.notes: Connect page: the search now counts the seconds, and after fifteen says what is usually wrong - the model needs powering with the transmitter off, or another phone or tablet is holding it, since a receiver takes one at a time.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.790-no-connect-on-launch
versions.notes: Opening the app no longer connects to anything: it used to seize the last model the moment Bluetooth came up, which is why a tablet left on the side could lock a receiver out of the phone - a receiver takes one at a time. Searching and connecting now begin only on the Connect page, as they should.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.789-connect-honest
versions.notes: Connect page: it now says what it is doing — connecting, or why a connection failed — instead of failing in silence, and a receiver that has gone quiet drops off the list rather than sitting there untappable. A receiver takes one phone or tablet at a time, and the timeout message now says so: that was the real reason a listed model would not open.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.788-return-to-front-screen
versions.notes: One name for one action: the front page's button and the Bluetooth badge on every page both now say Return to front screen, and both take you there — from a live model, a demo or a recording alike.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.787-quiet-front-screen
versions.notes: Front screen: the 'Connecting to…' line is gone — it said nothing the model's own pages do not say a second later. A real problem, such as Bluetooth being switched off, is still shown.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.786-connect-fix-and-no-small-text
versions.notes: Fixes a receiver that was listed but would not connect: opening the Connect page again while a connection was under way silently cancelled it, because starting a search resets the link. Searching is now refused whenever a connection is in progress or live. Also removes the small text sitting on the photograph — it is all in each screen's help.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.785-full-colour-and-three-demos
versions.notes: The app's front screens: the flying-field photograph in full colour behind every one, the title centred as LockDown Radio Control RXV2, and a help page of its own on Connect, Reviews, Backups and Demos. The Demos page now offers all three roles one board can take - Receiver, Rotorflight dongle and Simulator interface - and its help explains that they are the same board doing different jobs.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.784-one-word-doors
versions.notes: First screen: titled LDRC RXV2, four one-word buttons — Connect, Reviews, Backups, Demos — and no small print. Searching, and the jump straight to the model used last, now begin only when Connect is tapped. The help page shares the same backdrop as everything else and carries the app version.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.783-four-doors
versions.notes: The first screen is now a proper menu: Connect, Reviews, Backups and Demos, each a button in the app's usual style with its own page. Backups is new — it shows what the phone has saved for each model, when, and whether you made it or it was kept for you. The backdrop wash is stronger so the text reads easily.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.782-first-screen-tidy
versions.notes: The model list — the first screen you see — now looks like the rest of the app: the flying-field backdrop, solid cards, and a ? that explains the whole screen properly. The blocks of small print are gone, replaced by one line each and a full help page covering how a model appears, signal strength, photographs, what a review is and how a backup differs.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.781-review-says-what-it-is
versions.notes: The model list now says what a review is: each row reads 'Last session' with the time, and the note underneath explains that these are recorded for you at every connection and that a backup is a different thing you make yourself.

rotorflight.line: Rotorflight 2.3 — the release these pages are written and tested against.
